page_title: CHE 0-1 MNU | Chelsea v Manchester Utd 18/04/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+4' Kobbie Mainoo (Manchester United) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
90+4' A free kick into the box, taken by Pedro Neto (Chelsea), is comfortably cleared by the opposition's defence.
90+4' Handball by Mason Mount (Manchester United). Chelsea win a free kick.
90+3' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
90+1' Mason Mount (Manchester United) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
90' We will have 4 min. of added time.
88' Liam Rosenior prepares a substitution. Enzo Fernandez is replaced by Romeo Lavia (Chelsea).
87' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Bryan Mbeumo as he is replaced by Joshua Zirkzee (Manchester United).
87' That's unlucky! Liam Delap (Chelsea) beautifully controls a pass and from the edge of the box drills a shot in on goal, but it's inadvertently blocked by a defender and cleared.
85' Moises Caicedo (Chelsea) picks up a pass and fires a powerful long-range shot which goes painfully close to the left post.
83' Diogo Dalot (Manchester United) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
81' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Trevoh Chalobah (Chelsea) comes onto the pitch for Wesley Fofana.
81' Substitution. Malo Gusto walks off the pitch and Josh Acheampong (Chelsea) comes on as a substitute.
81' Michael Carrick has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Mason Mount (Manchester United) replacing Matheus Cunha.
80' Benjamin Sesko comes off the pitch to be replaced by Amad Diallo (Manchester United).
80' A cross into the box from Malo Gusto (Chelsea) is cleared.
77' Marc Cucurella (Chelsea) is penalised for a foul. Michael Oliver had a clear view and blows his whistle.
72' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Chelsea.
72' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) unleashes a powerful shot from the free kick but it only hits the defensive wall.

71' Noussair Mazraoui (Manchester United) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Michael Oliver no option but to blow his whistle. Chelsea are awarded a free kick from a dangerous position.
70' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 13:4.
70' Chelsea hold the ball and display nice passing from player to player.
70' Alejandro Garnacho (Chelsea) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
67' Wesley Fofana (Chelsea) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his header from the six-yard box wasn't accurate enough and the ball glanced away off the bar!
67' The corner is swung in but Chelsea can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
67' Chelsea quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.

66' Pedro Neto (Chelsea) connects with a pass but sees his shot from the edge of the box blocked. Chelsea have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
65' Manchester Utd failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

63' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his strike from the six-yard box wasn't accurate enough and the ball went a few inches wide of the right post.
59' Surely that's handball by one of the Manchester Utd players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
59' Malo Gusto (Chelsea) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
57' The resulting set piece from Chelsea is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
57' Liam Delap (Chelsea) latches on to a superb cross inside the box but only hits the crossbar with a fine header. What a chance!
55' Matheus Cunha (Manchester United) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Michael Oliver blows his whistle for a foul.
54' Matheus Cunha (Manchester United) pulls the trigger and strikes the ball towards goal from long-range, but his effort is blocked by one of the defenders.

53' What a great effort! Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) decides to unleash a long-range shot. Despite hitting it very well, it scorches inches wide of the right post. We could have witnessed a magnificent goal.
52' Chelsea take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

52' Moises Caicedo (Chelsea) hammers the ball towards goal from long-range, but one of the defenders reacts brilliantly to block the shot. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Chelsea.
49' Senne Lammens displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Marc Cucurella (Chelsea) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
48' Chelsea are showcasing great team work and neat passing moves.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+6' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+4' Noussair Mazraoui (Manchester United) pulls the shirt of his opponent and the referee stops play for a foul. Chelsea get a free kick.

45+3' Malo Gusto (Chelsea) found some space to dink a cross from the side into the box, but it needed to be more precise to threaten the opposition. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Manchester Utd.
45+2' Chelsea take a short corner kick.
45+2' Chelsea keep the ball and are displaying some tiki-taka style passing at the moment.
45' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
43' 0 - 1 Goal! Matheus Cunha (Manchester United) finds himself some space inside the box to get on the end of a pass from Bruno Fernandes, then sends the ball inside the right post. 0:1.
42' The game is interrupted now, Wesley Fofana (Chelsea) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
40' Casemiro (Manchester United) commits a foul and Michael Oliver immediately signals a free kick.
39' Jorrel Hato (Chelsea) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
38' The assistant referee raises his flag and the referee blows his whistle. Liam Delap (Chelsea) puts the ball into the net, but he is flagged for offside.
38' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
36' Diogo Dalot (Manchester United) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
36' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Senne Lammens, who smothers the ball.
33' Close! A mistake by a defender gifts Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea) a chance inside the box, but his efforts curls just around the right post.
32' Malo Gusto (Chelsea) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
30' Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea) takes a short run up and tries to place the ball from the free kick, but the defensive wall blocks the effort.
29' Ayden Heaven (Manchester United) is penalised after knocking an opponent down. Chelsea win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.
29' 2:1 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams.
25' Matheus Cunha (Manchester United) has tested the patience of referee Michael Oliver and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
24' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) tries to find Benjamin Sesko, but he puts too much power on the through ball.
22' Marc Cucurella (Chelsea) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent. A free kick has been awarded to Manchester Utd.
20' Matheus Cunha (Manchester United) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off.
18' Alejandro Garnacho (Chelsea) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball.
17' It looks like Luke Shaw (Manchester United) saw red with that tackle. Michael Oliver won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
16' Estêvão is being substituted because of an injury. Liam Rosenior sends Alejandro Garnacho (Chelsea) on the pitch.
15' Estêvão (Chelsea) looks like he won’t be able to continue.
14' Estêvão (Chelsea) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
11' Estêvão (Chelsea) decided to surprise the goalkeeper with a quick shot from the edge of the box, but his effort came back off the left post!
10' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) breaks into the box and goes over after a challenge from an opposition player, but the ref signals NO penalty!
9' A spell of possession for Chelsea in an attempt to control the game.
7' Benjamin Sesko (Manchester United) collects a pass and has an effort from distance which is blocked.
5' A quickly taken corner by Chelsea.
4' Manchester Utd string together a series of short passes.
3' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) delivers a poor cross from a free kick as one of the defenders comfortably clears it away.
3' Moises Caicedo (Chelsea) commits a rough challenge and Michael Oliver blows his whistle for a foul. Manchester Utd earn a free kick.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Manchester Utd will kick the game off.
Michael Oliver will supervise the game today.
